title: 绮怀·其十五（几回花下坐吹箫）
author: 黄景仁
intro: A poet remembers the nights he played the flute under the flowers for a girl he could not have. “These stars are not last night’s stars — for whom do I stand in the wind and dew at midnight?” One of the most loved lines of the Qing dynasty.
analysis: 《绮怀》是黄景仁回忆年轻时一段恋情的组诗，共十六首，这是第十五首。开头写过去：多少次在花下坐着吹箫，可是那人住在红墙里面，像隔着天上的银河一样远，只能远远地望着。第三、四句最有名：今晚的星辰已经不是从前那一夜的星辰了，我又是为了谁，在风露里站到半夜？这里化用了唐代李商隐的诗句“昨夜星辰昨夜风”，物是人非的感觉很强。第五、六句用了两个比喻：情思就像抽尽了的残茧，“丝”和“思”同音，是双关（一个词同时有两层意思）；心痛就像剥开以后的芭蕉，一层一层，心已经伤透。最后说：想起她十五岁那年的十五月圆之夜，那一杯酒到今天还没有消散。全诗把思念写得缠绵深切，让人难忘。
analysisEn: “Tender Memories” is a set of sixteen poems in which Huang Jingren looks back on a love from his youth; this is the fifteenth. It opens with the past: how many times he sat under the flowers playing his flute, while she lived behind red walls — as far away as the Milky Way, only to be gazed at from afar. The second couplet is the famous one: these stars are not the stars of that night long ago, so for whom am I standing in the wind and dew until midnight? It echoes a line by the Tang poet Li Shangyin, “last night’s stars, last night’s wind”, and gives a strong sense of the place being the same while the person is gone. The third couplet uses two comparisons. His tangled longing is like the last silk drawn from a spent cocoon — and since 丝 (“silk”) sounds just like 思 (“longing”), the line is a pun with two meanings at once. His heartache is like a banana plant peeled layer by layer until nothing is left. The last couplet remembers a full-moon night when she was fifteen: the wine he drank then has still not worn off. The longing in this poem is soft, lingering and very hard to forget.
background: Huang Jingren (1749–1783) was a gifted Qing poet who lived in poverty and died at 34. The “Tender Memories” series is traditionally believed to recall his youthful love for a young woman — said to be a cousin — whom he could not marry.
pronunciation: 几回 jǐ；为谁 wèi；中宵 zhōng xiāo；缠绵 chán mián；剥后蕉 bāo（单用的动词按口语读 bāo，也有人按书面读 bō）；不曾 céng。
version: 采用通行版本（《两当轩集》）。《绮怀》共十六首，这是第十五首。

lines.py: jǐ huí huā xià zuò chuī xiāo
lines.lit: How many times I sat under the flowers playing the flute;
lines.en: How often I sat beneath the flowers playing my flute,

lines.py: yín hàn hóng qiáng rù wàng yáo
lines.lit: the Silver River, the red wall — far away in my gaze.
lines.en: your red wall as far from me as the Milky Way.

lines.py: sì cǐ xīng chén fēi zuó yè
lines.lit: Stars like these are not those of last night;
lines.en: These stars are not the stars of that night,

lines.py: wèi shuí fēng lù lì zhōng xiāo
lines.lit: for whom do I stand in wind and dew in the middle of the night?
lines.en: so for whom do I stand in the wind and dew at midnight?

lines.py: chán mián sī jìn chōu cán jiǎn
lines.lit: Tangled longing used up, like silk drawn from a spent cocoon;
lines.en: My longing is drawn out to the end, like the last silk from a cocoon;

lines.py: wǎn zhuǎn xīn shāng bāo hòu jiāo
lines.lit: winding heartache, like a banana plant after peeling.
lines.en: my heart, peeled layer by layer like a banana stem, has nothing left.

lines.py: sān wǔ nián shí sān wǔ yuè
lines.lit: In the year of fifteen, under the moon of the fifteenth,
lines.en: That full-moon night in the year you were fifteen —

lines.py: kě lián bēi jiǔ bù céng xiāo
lines.lit: pitiably, that cup of wine has never worn off.
lines.en: sadly, the wine I drank then has never worn off.

words.note: 绮：美丽的丝织品，引申为美好、艳丽。

words.en: to play the xiao (a vertical bamboo flute)
the Silver River — the Milky Way
a cocoon with its silk nearly used up

words.note: 口语读 bāo（剥皮），书面复合词读 bō（剥削）。
芭蕉，层层包裹，剥开后中间是空的。
古诗常用：三五年时＝十五岁；三五月＝十五的月亮。

imagery.name: 银河
imagery.zh: 红墙像银河一样把两人隔开，近在眼前却不能相见。
imagery.en: The red wall divides them like the Milky Way — so close, and impossible to cross.

imagery.name: 春蚕
imagery.zh: 情思像抽到最后的蚕丝，“丝”“思”双关，写出思念不断、几近耗尽。
imagery.en: Longing drawn out like the last thread of a cocoon — 丝 “silk” punning on 思 “longing”.

imagery.name: 芭蕉
imagery.zh: 芭蕉一层层剥开后心是空的，比喻伤心到了极点。
imagery.en: A banana stem peeled layer by layer until its heart is empty — heartbreak taken to the end.
